notes.title: BIG UPDATE - VERSION 0.23
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/d03159587fbb41e2488a23429033aad2fabd5c22.png[/img]

Hello dear soldier! It's been a while since there was an update! But we're still here. Before talking about the update itself, I wanted to introduce Burner to you. He is the 3D animator /Sound designer and is joining the project in the long term. Thanks to his expertise, the game has a better visual appearance and development will be faster due to the distribution of loads.

Saturday was release the biggest update, the game gets a makeover. Change of name, easier to find, change of logo and change of vision. The roleplay has been removed, it is now a classic FPS which will focus on matches between clans still in mil-sim.

[b]>> New UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/371e8a52cce396506ed6d1d68f4024be3f420540.png[/img] [list]
[*] Revisited UI main menu
[*] UI in game 
[/list]
[b]>> Ballistics[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/0d5f71b99099020720e968216c7882026566e90d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Gravity on bullets rebuild
[*] Recoil up/down rebuild 
[*] Add Power of bullet
[/list]
[b]>> VOIP System[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/64352375ace55f764e0b61e85501a93f04660575.png[/img]
[list]
[*] You can communicate with all player on push to talk microphone
[/list]
[b]>> New character 3D[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/e5284f574662295c629aff83f1c0cc16e4cf8e04.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The character 3d has been changed, lighter and more realistic
[/list]
[b]>> Animation[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/af122643b501bd1aa6012f7a4ad6415cfbfdd8f7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Weapon animation completely redone and 80+ animation of caractère edited
[/list]
[b]>> Maps[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/1e4790d7e1bfdd02f8620d734ae8fb6b25e428ee.png[/img]
WAREHOUSE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/ff4bb846836cfd24af2ab92bc83ad67f751573b8.png[/img]
INDUSTRIAL
[list]
[*] Two new maps integrated into the game!
[/list]

[b]>> Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33790114/af122643b501bd1aa6012f7a4ad6415cfbfdd8f7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 3 news weapons + new system scope. Come on to see this ːlunar2019grinningpigː
[/list]

The owners of the game have just updated, their account is still the same. For those who were in beta mode on Steam Please switch to live mode.

We hope you enjoy all the new features, see you in the game!

To celebrate this update we are doing a session on Sunday Sunday at 9h30 PM GMT+1. Click and join the discord for information! [url=https://discord.gg/3H78JETX?event=1184035990650769418]JOIN EVENT[/url]

[b]Hypy & Burner[/b]
